content: An agent brings a model, skill sets and knowledge bases together and shares that setup with the people you invite.

comment.text: Description on the empty screen of the Agents list in the AI Chat section for a user who may create one: what a agent is and why to create it. Terms: agent = an AI assistant set up with a model, skill sets and knowledge bases; skill set = a room of skills (Markdown instructions); knowledge base = a room of files the assistant searches. Match Common:Agents, Common:SkillSets, Common:AIProjectKnowledgeRooms.
